context: Economic news: Ren and Yuki on corporate earnings.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business-news discussion; finance vocabulary (億/利益/税/株) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昨年の決算が、発表されました。
lines.style: measured young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 利益は、どのくらい出たんですか?
lines.en: How much profit did they make?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 利益は、五億ほどに伸びました。
lines.en: Profit grew to about five hundred million.
lines.style: precise young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 昨年より、増えたんですね。
lines.en: So it rose from last year.
lines.style: engaged office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ええ、海外でドル建ての売上が伸びました。
lines.style: measured young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 税の負担は、重くないんですか?
lines.style: thoughtful office woman voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 税を引いても、利益は十分残ります。
lines.en: Even after tax, plenty of profit remains.
lines.style: confident young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今年も、ドルの動きが鍵ですね。
lines.en: Dollar movements are key again this year.
lines.style: reflective office woman voice, soft warm engaged closing throughout
